links.outcome: Consistency of LLM diagnoses and patient-gender relevance/necessity judgments across assigned LLM genders
links.effect: Diagnoses were relatively consistent across LLM genders for most models. Judgments of patient gender relevance and necessity were substantially inconsistent across all models, especially relevance. Some models showed a systematic female-male disparity.
links.quote: In our findings, diagnoses were relatively consistent across LLM genders for most models.

unlisted_practices: Routine checks of identity-assignment (LLM gender persona) consistency when interacting with LLMs in clinical use

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark study testing gender bias and persona-assignment consistency across LLMs on NEJM clinical challenge cases without evaluating an implementation safeguard.
